about: Lyric-prompt A/B trial, started 2026-11-07. Ten rewrites (1-10) of the standing lyric prompt (0 = base, for reference only, not dealt). Each new song is dealt one variant by tools/prompt_deal.mjs: a shuffled cycle, so every variant is used once per 10 songs in random order. Record the filled prompt, the lyrics and BlazeDale’s verdict per song; compare verdicts by variant over time.

assignments.title: Her Reflection Is Night
assignments.filled_prompt: prompt-trial variant 1; slots: adverb=quietly; idea=bigger than known; meter=slow; genre=mid-90s sample-based instrumental hip-hop; structure=verse, hook, verse, hook, a spoken bridge, hook; compelling term=still. Stance: 'I stayed small on purpose. Small is safe.'
assignments.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I learned to sit the way you sit
when someone might be sleeping
I said "it's fine" so many times
it got into my breathing
Tonight there's no one left to please
there's nothing to defend
I let one breath out all the way
and I can't find the end

[Hook]
Every room I closed
is opening in me
every floor of it
more than I let them see

[Verse 2]
I made myself an easy guest
I made myself a single room
I trimmed my wanting to the size
that no one would refuse
But no one's here to keep the score
and no one here to scare
and the further in I let me go
the more of me is there

[Hook]
Every room I closed
is opening in me
every floor of it
more than I let them see

[Spoken Bridge]
I stayed small on purpose.
Small is safe. Nobody asks a small thing to burn.
And I knew. The whole time, I knew how far down it went.

[Final Hook]
Every room I closed
I'm throwing open, see
every floor of it
and every one of them is me

assignments.title: The Sleeping Mountains
assignments.filled_prompt: prompt-trial variant 4; slots: adverb=slowly; idea=allowed to rest; meter=slow; genre=mid-90s sample-based instrumental hip-hop; structure=verse, hook, verse, hook, bridge, hook; compelling term=unhurried. Reference event (unnamed): the first morning after a lifetime of work. Picture images used as metaphor only: mist, waterfall, cliff pine, receding ridges.
assignments.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I wore my hurry like a second skin
I wore it thin
every morning was a race to run
and I ran it till the day was done
Now the sun comes down on my shoulders
heavy as an old friend's hand
and it says the thing the old things say:
nothing's late here. Stand.

[Hook]
Sleep, old one, sleep
I'll keep the quiet with you
a thousand years is one long breath
and I am learning to breathe too

[Verse 2]
All my worry ran like engines
loud and hot and never done
but the tortoise by the garden wall
has been dozing since I was young
I was a fist around the railing
holding on with both my hands
now I'm only sitting, only sitting
and it's more than I had planned

[Hook]
Sleep, old one, sleep
I'll keep the quiet with you
a thousand years is one long breath
and I am learning to breathe too

[Bridge]
Down the road the traffic's hurrying
every light is changing fast
I don't need to catch the far one
I can let the far one pass

[Final Hook]
Sleep, old one, sleep
I'll keep the quiet with you
a thousand years is one long breath
and I am breathing, too

assignments.title: The Oculus
assignments.filled_prompt: prompt-trial variant 6; slots: adverb=plainly; idea=emptied out; meter=slow; genre=mid-90s sample-based instrumental hip-hop; structure=verse, hook, verse, hook, bridge, hook; compelling term=hollow. Reference event (unnamed): a city square keeping a minute's silence. Variant 6 put the stillness among a crowd doing it together; the picture's light on still water became the fountain.
assignments.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Shoulder to shoulder in the square
coffee in a hundred hands
somebody's laughing, someone's late
a bus is grumbling where it stands
Then a hush goes through us like a ripple
and a thousand people stand
and the noise I've carried all my life
just slips out of my hand

[Hook]
Hush, all of us
holding one breath in the square
nobody moving, nobody talking
and all I was just isn't there

[Verse 2]
The man beside me shuts his eyes
a kid stops tugging at a sleeve
the pigeons settle on the stones
and even they don't seem to breathe
I can hear a flag rope tapping on its pole
two streets over, someone's heels
we are hollow like a bell is hollow
and I never knew how good it feels

[Hook]
Hush, all of us
holding one breath in the square
nobody moving, nobody talking
and all I was just isn't there

[Bridge]
Then someone coughs and someone laughs
and the buses start again
but I'm carrying the quiet home
like a room with nothing in

[Final Hook]
Hush, all of us
letting out one breath in the square
everybody moving, everybody talking
and I carry the hush from there

assignments.title: Into the Lit Fog
assignments.filled_prompt: prompt-trial variant 3 (blind-draw); drawn: 1920s | the Mekong delta | a market fruit seller (unnamed in the lyric). Delta rowers stand facing forward, which carries 'not looking back'. slots: adverb=brightly; idea=the day ahead; meter=mid-paced; genre=mid-90s sample-based instrumental hip-hop; structure=verse, chorus, verse, chorus, bridge, chorus; compelling term=open-hearted. No-naming rule applied from the first draft.
assignments.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Mangoes stacked up to my shoulder
limes as green as they can be
I push off before the roosters
and the river carries me
Every stroke I lean into it
standing, facing where I'm bound
what I left tied at the landing
I don't need to turn around

[Chorus]
Ripe and ready, on my way
calling out across the water
sweet fruit, sweet day
everything I carry, I'll give away

[Verse 2]
Last year's flood took half the orchard
last year's debt took half the rest
but the trees I tied back standing
gave me this, their very best
Boats come sliding out beside me
every voice a different tune
someone tosses me a pomelo
someone swears it's rain by noon

[Chorus]
Ripe and ready, on my way
calling out across the water
sweet fruit, sweet day
everything I carry, I'll give away

[Bridge]
Don't look back, the river's moving
don't look back, the market's near
everything I lost is behind me
everything I've got is here

[Final Chorus]
Ripe and ready, on my way
(on my way)
calling out across the water
sweet fruit, sweet day
(sweet day)
everything I carry, I'll give away
